about: Where each live design is in Figma right now. The one home for Figma file keys, pages and frame ids. Chadwick moves files between his two Figma accounts, so a pointer anywhere else goes stale; every other file points here. Read it before any Figma call. When a frame is not where this says, search the other files in `files` by frame name before telling him anything is missing or blocked, then update the entry. Check: node scripts/check-figma-locations.mjs
